notes:
Summary: Commercial-stage clinical research AI company evaluating Redwood for embeddings + summarization POC. Primary blocker: strict EU-only data residency requirement (legal & patient data) — procurement and security will not approve multi-region. Short-hand notes below.

Initial interest: strong — use case = de-identified trial notes summarization and cohort search using embeddings.
POC scope: 10k docs, embeddings + retrieval + summarization, latency SLO ~200ms for retrieval path, cost sensitivity moderate.
Security asks: SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS integration, explicit EU-only hosting guarantee in contract.
Redwood fit: runtime & batching fine; main gap = cannot promise single-tenant EU-only hosted region currently.
Sales timeline: 
- 2024-09-10 intro call (AE Maya, CTO Lukas Meyer) — positive.
- 2024-09-17 POC kickoff (Fireflies ff-2024-09-17-quantifyai).
- 2024-10-03 security deep-dive (Fireflies ff-2024-10-03-security-call) — compliance insisted on EU-only residency.
- 2024-11-21 procurement paused due to company-wide budget freeze.
- 2025-01-30 final procurement call — customer chose BlueCloud AI (they offered EU-only managed region).

Quote: "We need an EU-only region — our legal team will not accept any multi-region hosting." — CTO L. Meyer.

Follow-up plan: Closed-lost for now; track roadmap for Redwood EU single-tenant offering, touch base if/when EU-only managed region becomes available. Recommend internal note to include this account in EU-region launch pilot outreach.
